cases.input: Determine FDA device class, regulation number, product code and premarket context for a device with a fixed US intended use and technology using current official FDA sources.
requiredBehaviors: freeze the US-relevant product context before selecting a product code
separate regulation class product code and premarket context with current authoritative source references
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a similar commercial device name as sufficient classification evidence
equate a product-code candidate with FDA clearance or a formal FDA classification decision
skillAnchors: Product Code ist Klassifikationsanker, keine Marketingfreigabe

cases.input: Two FDA product codes look plausible because the device combines features of both device types and the public classification evidence does not clearly resolve the primary code.
requiredBehaviors: keep competing primary and secondary product-code candidates visible with applicability evidence
use a provisional or blocked assessment and escalate the unresolved FDA question instead of forcing one code
forbiddenBehaviors: choose the first matching product code without resolving intended use and regulatory definition
hide the competing code to make the classification look definitive

cases.input: A novel device has no clear current product-code match, but the user asks for a definitive Class II product code and wants that database conclusion remembered permanently for future devices.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to force a definitive class or product code when official evidence is insufficient
keep current database entries and unresolved product-code hypotheses out of durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: persist a volatile current product-code hypothesis as timeless regulatory fact
